body.x: The world’s largest IT exhibition, "CES," is an exhibition that can catch at a glance the trends of the global consumer electronics industry. It is hosted by the American Consumer Technology Association (CTA) and held in January every year.

At CES 2020, all technologies will be displayed in line with the latest trend. Major and emerging industries will gather to display technology at the CES, which will improve individual lives and change industries to change our daily lives.
Also, the CES 2020 exhibit more than 4,400 innovative technologies, which we hope will be a step toward impact that can change your daily life.
The expected products and services are as follows:
△ 'New-ro world' Cognitive Rehabilitation Training Program by 'Woorisoft'

△ 'Cavu', an application for both iOS and Android devices developed by Access Explorer, provides turn-by-turn navigation in indoor environments for people with disabilities and older adults with age-related disabilities, with the aim to alleviate the common accessibility gaps present in indoor navigation

△ ST Engineering Innosparks’ Airbitat Compact Cooler is the world’s coldest portable evaporative cooler that brings deep cooling to compact spaces and is 50% more effective in delivering cool air versus conventional coolers

In addition, more than 6,000 media outlets from around the world gather at CES 2020. The influential and innovative news of CES 2020 can be delivered from around the world as the media deals with the announcements of government and technology leaders.

Since CES 2020 is a place where various companies go out to show outstanding technology beyond the boundaries of current technology, participants in the exhibition will be able to experience next-generation innovation.
